name: @pineappleui/gallery
description: Ladle gallery that renders every @pineappleui package's stories from source.

tasksNotApplicable.test: Renders other packages' stories and owns no runtime code of its own, so there is nothing here a unit test could assert that the component packages do not already cover. What this workspace can get wrong -- a story that no longer compiles, an alias that stops resolving, a decorator that breaks every story -- is caught by `build` (`ladle build` compiles every discovered story) and `typecheck`.
